lede: San Francisco 49ers carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#2 in EPA per play), while Denver Broncos owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#5 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it San Francisco 49ers -2.0 with a fair total of 45.1 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Denver Broncos pass offence vs San Francisco 49ers pass defence, which sits +0.081 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Denver Broncos and San Francisco 49ers have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
